dispute_ticket.description: I was only about two minutes late and told the driver I was coming down. He cancelled anyway and was rude about it. I was charged $5.00 as a no-show. I was in a hurry and already stressed, please refund it.

chat_logs.content: I am at the pickup point, Exit C, grey Corolla.
So sorry, coming down in 2 mins!
Waited more than 6 min already. Cancelling.

app_events.details: Rider R-7103 booked trip RYDE-DS-003 from Compass One to Waterway Point. Pickup 08:10.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'; GPS within 20 m of pickup point.
Driver cancelled; reason: rider did not board. Wait 6 min 20 s counted from driver_arrived. No-show fee S$5.00 applied.
Rider app location within 30 m of pickup point.
Cancellation screen showed a duplicate 'trip cancelled' banner on the rider's app; fee was charged only once.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show. The count is inclusive.

no_show_fee.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when the rider counts as a no-show. It governs rider no-shows, not cancellations caused by the driver.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The driver arrived at 08:10:00 (GPS within 20 m and a driver_arrived event) and cancelled at 08:16:20, a wait of 6 min 20 s. This trip's policy sets the no-show threshold at 6 minutes counted from arrival, inclusive, so the condition was met, and the rider's own app ping at 08:17:40 shows she reached the pickup only after the cancellation. The S$5.00 no-show fee stands; the rider's short delay, her hurry and the driver's curt tone do not change that.
